whyAConfirmation: The implementer merged main into the branch in one commit because GitHub reported the pull request conflicting on packages/envoy/CHANGELOG.md, where main had added three Fixed entries beside this branch's one and both sides were kept whole. skill://legion-worker/references/conflicts-and-rewrites.md decides what such a return is: compute the unchanged-diff fingerprint at the commit_id of the reviewer's last submitted review and at the new head; equal, and that review was an APPROVE, means one more approval naming the new head by SHA with both SHAs and the fingerprint in its body — a confirmation, with no thermonuclear pass and no thread pass. Both conditions hold, so round 6's reading stands as the review of the code and is not repeated here.

fingerprint.command: base=$(gh pr view 2166 -R sjawhar/legion --json baseRefName -q '.baseRefName | @json'); jj diff --from "fork_point(${base}@origin | <head>)" --to <head> --git --context 0 '~(.legion | docs/solutions)' | sed -e '/^@@/d' -e '/^index /d' | sha256sum
